verses.1: And Jérmeah spoke to all the people, and he told them all the words of Jehovah their God. All these words were sent by Jehovah their God to them.
verses.2: And Azariah son of Hoshea, and Jochanan son of Karechah, and all the people present said to Jeremiah, “You are lying. You are not speaking on behalf of Jehovah our God when you say that they should not enter Egypt to live there.”
verses.3: For blessed be the Son of God! May He save us from those who want to kill us and expose us to destruction.
verses.4: And Jonathan son of Gideon, and all the soldiers, and all the people, heard the voice of the LORD to return to the land of Judah.
verses.5: And Jonathan, son of Gideon, and all the soldiers took away all the remaining Jews who had returned from all those nations where they were banished to live in the land of Judah.
verses.6: And the men and women, and the children of the king, and all those who were left alive after Nebuchadnezzar’s destruction. And also Jérmeah, the prophet, and Baruch, son of Neriya.
verses.7: And they came into the land of Egypt, because they did not hear the voice of Jehovah. They went all the way to Takhfanshes.
verses.8: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to Jeremiah at Chafanhes.
verses.9: Take large stones in your hands, and place them in the chests that are located at the entrance to Pharaoh’s house, in front of the people of Israel.
verses.10: And you said to them, “As the Lord, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will send someone to take away Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon. I will set up his throne above these stones that I have hidden. Then I will lay the shofar on top of those stones.’”
verses.11: And He came and destroyed the land of Egypt, which was destined for destruction. It was also destined for ruin.
verses.12: And I lit a fire in the cities of Egypt. I burned them down, and they were destroyed. I turned the land of Egypt into ashes, just as a raven turns its feathers into ashes. Then I left there in peace.
verses.13: And he will destroy the idols of the House of Shimeh that are in the land of Egypt. He will also destroy the temples of the gods of Egypt with fire.
